evidence.producer: PROVISIONAL: Compiler releases Program and source buffer at sealed Core/Module boundary and invokes a registered backend on immutable Core functions, ModuleIR and machine TargetInfo. The backend facade requires the expected registered target and preflight-valid module.
consumers: src/target/common/program_emit.c:minic_program_emit_module_preflight rejects invalid finalized Module, mismatched live CoreTypeContext and function counts, without confusing an un-emitted declaration with a live definition

src/target/common/program_emit.c:minic_program_emit_write_module opens a unique .minic-XXXXXX staging file adjacent to destination, performs optional prefix, undefined ELF bindings, globals, file-scope ASM, prepared functions, trailer, fclose and optional target finalize before rename

The same writer removes the temporary on any failed stage, close, finalizer or rename; final .s output is not replaced on failure. A deliberate diagnostic/census continue_after_failure mode may still scan functions but cannot commit unsuccessful results

src/target/common/program_visit.c creates/destroys each temporary CoreFunctionPlan around the target callback, while src/target/common/machine_production_preflight.h requires entire typed MachineIR body and GNU ASM binding to be checked before emitting function bytes

src/target/common/direct_program_emit.c adapts A64/Loong direct emitters to the common transaction, but target-specific ELF directives, symbol syntax, global relocation and ISA finalizer callback remain explicit owners

tests/compiler/c0/probe-program-emit-transaction.c injects staged prefix/global/between/function/finalize failures; probe-module-emit-preflight-contract.c exercises forged module and foreign type arenas
evidence.functional_path: C08 PROVISIONAL output ownership chain: Compiler verifies and seals CoreFunctionSet+ModuleIR -> destroys C Program and source buffer -> target backend catalog validates architecture and a common preflight snapshot -> Target/common creates private same-directory .s staging file -> predeclare undefined weak/hidden actual references, globals/aliases, copied Module file ASM, prepared Core functions -> per-function target ABI→typed MachineIR complete preflight -> output close and optional target finalization -> atomic rename into requested path; any failure removes private file and leaves old public result intact. Output transaction is common; semantic ISA directives remain private per target.
limitations: UNTRUSTED C08 proposal, not all five per-target file finalizers/ELF relocation paths or error injection configurations reviewed.
Provenance of .s public transaction must not be confused with real .o ELF assembler/linker or QEMU execution success.
Preserve SOURCE file ASM bytes and GNU undefined weak/visibility behavior; removing extra symbol-use checks without proofs can introduce silent link differences.
Need same-input failure-injection tests for fopen/fclose/rename, cleanup of temp files, valid old output intact, ABI/target finalizer failures and platform-specific assembler oracles.
No correctness or performance equivalence claim made; do not certify C08 as MAPPED/VERIFIED.
